newsitem.title: UK: Racal says in UK helicopter upgrade talks.
newsitem.headline: Racal says in UK helicopter upgrade talks.

text.p: Racal Electronics said on Monday it is in contract negotiations with Britain's Ministry of Defence for the upgrade of the Sea King helicopter's radar system for early warning application.
"Recent selections are expected to result in orders worth over 150 million stg to Racal, once contract negotiations are completed," the company said in a statement.
The new breed of Sea King, which provides air and sea surface surveillance, will increase the navy's ability to direct attack aircraft onto designated targets.

Racal said it is to supply its new generation Searchwater 2000 airborne early warning radar as part of the upgrade. Under development for the past five years, this uses a new high power transmitter and advanced signal processing techniques.

"This selection is extremely important in consolidating Racal's position as a prime contractor for Ministry of Defence system upgrade programmes," said the chairman of the Racal Defence Radar Avionics Group, Barton Clarke.
